summary: Leodocus or Laodocus (Ancient Greek: Λεωδόκος / Λαόδοκος, "receiving the people") is an Argonaut from Argos, son of Bias and Pero and brother of Talaus and Areius. Apollonius, Valerius Flaccus, and the Orphic Argonautica list him among Jason's crew. Distinct from Aetolian, Tegean, Trojan, and Antenorid Laodoci.
etymology: Ancient Greek Λαόδοκος / Λεωδόκος — "receiving the people."

sections.heading: Argonaut son of Bias
paragraphs: Apollonius Rhodius (Argonautica 1.119) names Leodocus son of Bias and Pero among the Argive Argonauts, brother to Talaus and Areius. Valerius Flaccus and the Orphic Argonautica repeat the Biantid sailor. He belongs to the Aeolid house through Bias' marriage into Neleus' line via Pero.
He has no separate adventure beyond the voyage roll; the atlas id leodocus is this Argonaut alone.

sections.heading: Homonyms
paragraphs: Wikipedia's Laodocus page also lists an Aetolian son of Apollo and Phthia killed by Aetolus; a javelin-winner at Opheltes' funeral games; Ladocus son of Echemus and Timandra (eponym of Ladoceia); a bastard son of Priam; and Antenor's son whose shape Athena borrows to urge Pandarus to break the truce. None of those is the Argive Argonaut.
